player_prompt.intro:
Yaa ngone jàngoro {player_id} nekk ci poonare Checkers niki {color}.
Defaree poon wi ci màndarga xaree [fileRank fileRank], suturaale: '[b2c3]' (kolone bàkkar a–h, rëddu lim 0–7).
Yooniin jiitu:
  • Doxalee ci diggante wàll gi, bu jàllawul.
  • Jëlal ci kàpparalee ci kaw piece bi.
  • Ab piece mòy la bu àgg ci bànqaas bi.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Dekk bu njariñ move njëkk. Sàkk [a1b2], bési [b2c3].

outcome.red_no_pieces: Ndu rekki amul pisaas. Ndu ñuul ngone!
outcome.black_no_pieces: Ndu ñuul amul pisaas. Ndu rekki ngone!
